name: Logo
task: drawing, prompting or art-directing a logo: a symbol, a monogram, a wordmark, an emblem or a full identity mark
description: Logo styles as construction rules: the grid, the stroke contrast, the colour count, the minimum size, the clear space and the one-colour reversal. Each style links canonical evidence with an open licence or in the public domain. A free copyright licence does not remove trademark rights: a mark can be free to copy as an image and still be a registered trademark. Use the evidence as a reference for form, and do not reuse a mark for a product or a service.
